Claim: measurement and design for this card (the ruling on D1–D7 stays the maintainer's)
Session: session_01Q4EjjMnXJdSZifpEN5i7aU
Branch: `claude/sharp-cray-3nr8u9` · draft PR objectstack-ai/objectstack#34675 (`docs/design/mcp-local-first-door.md`)

Taken over at the maintainer's word in this session, 2026-11-17: 「你接手这个专题的完整测量与设计」.

Three readings that change the card's design (objectstack `62d9d0d99`); details and file lines are in the PR:

- **A draft save runs no authoring rule.** Only the type's Zod parse runs on a draft; the 40 runtime rules gate at publish (`packages/lint/src/authoring-rules.ts:186-205`, `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-authoring-gate.ts:430-445`). So "the save door stays authoritative and returns structured findings" does not hold for drafts: the draft tool has to return `draftPublishVerdict` itself.
- **An MCP OAuth token is not accepted on REST `/meta`** (`packages/runtime/src/http-dispatcher.ts:767`). This closes that "Not verified" row: the answer is no.
- **Studio draft review works with open packages only** (`ui/packages/app-shell/src/preview/` has no cloud import). This closes that row too.

Measurements in progress: the open door's token weight, and an A/B pilot of 问数 with and without a local skill. Results will land on the PR.

Note on channel: this session has no fleet App credentials, so this comment and the PR were written through the session's GitHub connector, not `scripts/pm/`.

Word 3 names this work as the 「MCP 二期与问数」 epic of objectstack-ai/objectstack#34632 D8.

**What was ruled**

| Point | Ruled | What it settles |
|:---|:---|:---|
| D1 | A | Open source gets the MCP draft write entry; the cloud pricing table's open-source cell for MCP build changes from source mode to that entry. Smart building stays cloud/EE |
| D2 | A | Drafts only on the self-hosted MCP door. No publish tool, no `force` |
| D3 | A | OAuth `metadata:write` only for the write entry |
| D4 | A | A different major of the client's spec is refused with the install line; a different minor is advised |
| D5 | A | The open server points to the local skills package. The `initialize` instructions also carry the short selection rule, because a client loads a tool's description only after choosing the tool |
| D6 | A | The open scenario cards are extended with datasets |
| D7 | A | 问数 first |
| E1 | A, enforce first | Rule content is open. A rule whose breach is runtime-dead metadata becomes a publish-time check first; prose moves to the published skills once it is stable. The cloud keeps the index, the triggers and the tier rendering |
| E3 | phased | The draft door returns the publish verdict of the saved draft. Of the local export / simulate / submit loop, only a local flow test run is built now; the rest waits for a request |
| E4 | A | The local path uses an API key, documented beside the MCP login. REST does not start accepting the MCP OAuth token |
| Seat | `pm-dispatch epic:#34659` | This session sits the epic seat on this card |

**E2 is ruled with a premise, not closed**

- Ruled: B for now. `list_datasets` stays exact-match and gains no candidates list.
- Premise, named and falsifiable: a skill-only branch (the client reads the unfiltered catalogue on a zero-match and asks back when several measures are a plausible reading) makes a client ask back on a near-miss word, and causes no ask-back on a question that has exactly one match. Measured at five repetitions on `examples/app-crm`.
- If the premise fails: the seat reports the fork to the maintainer. ⛔ No server change to `list_datasets` and no change to ADR-0149 D3 without a new word from the maintainer.

**Workload of the chosen letters** (lane · cards in the first milestone)

- 问数 (D5, D6, D7, E2): skills · devx · server, five cards.
- Draft door (D2, D3, D4, E1, E3): server · spec, filed when the 问数 milestone is in flight.
- D1: one cloud card, routed to the cloud PM.

For triage to file under this epic. It doesn't block objectstack-ai/objectstack#34977. Record: 6961115041, section ③.

**The ask-back rule isn't scoped to the measured word.** The executor offers candidates by containment in either direction, and dimensions count. So a grouping or time word sent as written can come back with a candidate while the measure word has its one exact match. Examples: 「按行业」 contains a dimension labelled 行业, "this quarter" contains one named `quarter`, and 本季度 contains 季度. Row 1 of the skill then says compute, while row 4 says ask and compute nothing. Row 5 is scoped and row 4 is not.

The skill is faithful to its sources. `LIST_DATASETS_DESCRIPTION`, `DATASET_SELECTION_RULE` and the ADR-0149 D3 note are just as unscoped, and clients already get the rule from the tool description on main. So the fix has to change all three texts together (door strings, ADR note and skill) to keep "one rule in the same words". It needs eval cases for a matched measure beside a candidate on another word, and for a dimension-only candidate (the L2's nit N1).
